exposure: non-insulin-based metabolic score for insulin resistance (METS-IR)
cohort: A total of 1810 euthyroid women in the first trimester of pregnancy who gave birth at Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital from November 2018 to November 2019 were included.
finding: Increasing METS-IR levels in euthyroid women during the first trimester of pregnancy are significantly associated with a higher risk of macrosomia and gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: No correlation was found between METS-IR and cesarean section.
